description: This file defines a React component named 'RoomsAdmin' that provides an administrative interface for managing hotel rooms. It includes functionalities such as listing rooms, adding new rooms, editing existing rooms, and deleting rooms. The component uses hooks for state management and effects, and interacts with external services for data operations.

methods.name: RoomsAdmin()
methods.description: React functional component for managing hotel rooms, including listing, adding, editing, and deleting rooms.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of rooms from the data service and updates the state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving of a room, either by creating a new one or updating an existing one, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified room and refreshes the list.
